entries.speaker: Elara
entries.content: You… remember the ruins. It has been a short time since our paths first crossed, hasn’t it? The forest feels your presence again, and not all of it is welcome.

entries.speaker: Elara
entries.content: You return. I had hoped, and yet… feared this moment. The shadows lengthen, and the whispers grow louder.

entries.speaker: Elara
entries.content: You seek me out again so soon. Do you bring news, or simply… trouble? The forest holds its breath, waiting.
